needs: commands.test set to `npm test` in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json, and the "Automated tests and total coverage" entry removed from capabilities.not_exercised. This PR adds the test runner the manifest said did not exist: `npm test` is `node --test` with Node's built-in coverage, it needs no new dependency and no service, and it writes coverage/lcov.info, which is one of the three paths `bsf gates coverage` already reads. Until the manifest names it, `bsf gates tests` runs nothing and the coverage gate finds no report, so these 35 tests are invisible to both gates and total coverage stays pinned at the 0% floor.
why: .factory/sandbox/** is protected by .factory/definition/policy.yaml, so a gardening PR cannot set commands.test itself; the runbook and history.md both predicted this exact handover ("whoever adds it should also set commands.test through an amendment"). Everything else was exercised here: `npm ci`, `npm test` (35 passing, 100% line/branch/function coverage of src/util.js and src/db.js), `npm run lint` (clean), and `node src/server.js` still boots and serves / and /health. Nothing outside the sandbox was needed - these are pure helpers and an in-process array.
